questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Soil is a complex resource whose condition affects water and life.
options: Soil is a complex resource whose condition affects water and life.

Soil appearance reveals all its properties.
Lost soil is always replaced immediately.

Although adding nutrients can influence production, it cannot automatically repair all the damage caused by erosion or compaction.

fiilin geçmişte tamamlandığını tek başına gösterir
soru sormak için kullanılır
